small_fit.scope: Training mechanics only; neither validation nor deployable quality evidence
small_fit.gate_scope: Predeclared final-step TRAIN-cohort fit check, not a convergence or model-selection test

losses.band_wave_control: Unchanged complement log-band/weighted-mask loss + mixture-normalized product waveform MSE, as in script 120
losses.reconstruction_l1: Mean per-example [waveform L1/(mixture RMS+0.001) + (real L1+imag L1)/(mixture mean real/imag absolute sum+0.001)]; both follow actual Gs interpolation, bounded real mask and LF250, equal coefficients; no band-mask target, no teacher loss
losses.context: Score waveform [(warmup+2)*256 : length-512] and complex frames [warmup+2 : T-2]; do not reset history within the crop
losses.caveat: Product-path supervision, not an optimal-mask oracle or an explicit guarantee of residual vocal suppression; these two normalized error views overlap

start_conditions: new independent electronic-vocal development and acceptance songs assigned before experimentation
formal_training_planned_not_started.selection: Existing script 119 gates remain unchanged; rank only eligible checkpoints. Save best eligible, final and full resume state. No eligible checkpoint means NONE.
formal_training_planned_not_started.comparison: Paired control/reconstruction arms from frozen weights; identical waveform batches, LR and stopping budget; no simultaneous layout, capacity or weak-vocal-weight change
formal_training_planned_not_started.status: Design budget, not an implemented/completed formal training run

acceptance.old_holdouts: Regression only; repeatedly observed and never called blind
acceptance.new_blind_target: At least 10 distinct electronic-vocal compositions, aiming for >=5 artists, reserved before future training; source rights and alignment reviewed; fingerprint/manual alias checks; no pseudo-label-only final reference
metrics: projected vocal residue and accompaniment gain (diagnostic only)
deployment_order: board timing and continuous speaker/button acceptance
